description: This file serves as the entry point for a React application. It imports React, ReactDOM, global CSS styles, and the main App component. It initializes the React rendering root and renders the App component within React's StrictMode.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a React root for rendering the application inside the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root element.
